name: Aether Field
source:
Magic does not exist. But what if it did?

William thought he wasn’t capable of using magic. But one day, by accident he managed to cast a spell. Now, he must learn how to repeat it and control his abilities in order to become an official mage. And who can help him better than girls who caused his power to manifest?

Follow the story of a group of six elementalists as they try to understand magic and themselves.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
魔法不存在。但如果真的发生了呢？

威廉认为他没有能力使用魔法。但有一天，他偶然施展了一个咒语。现在，他必须学会如何重复并控制自己的能力，才能成为一名正式的法师。还有谁能比让他的力量得以显现的女孩们更能帮助他呢？

跟随六位元素师尝试了解魔法和他们自己的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232120/]Steam[/url]]
